category_index: ../PAPER_CATEGORIES.md (C1 short/unspecified; C2 long-read feature; C3a/C3b single-cell truth x platform; source paper_categories.tsv)
category_policy: A: patient scDNA-supported reference tree; B: long-read/linked-read/local order or transferable haplotype phylogeny. No claim that all B papers infer complete clone trees from native long reads.

papers.title: Tracking clonal evolution during treatment in ovarian cancer using cell-free DNA
papers.long_feature: allele-specific CN, no native long reads
papers.tree_evidence: MEDICC2 CN phylogeny; curated clone clades

papers.title: Characterizing the evolutionary dynamics of cancer proliferation in single-cell clones with SPRINTER
papers.tree_evidence: HUNTRESS SNV topology; MEDICC2 CNA reconstruction with fixed topology

papers.title: Application of high-throughput single-nucleus DNA sequencing in pancreatic cancer
papers.tree_evidence: SCG clone genotypes and event hierarchy; main detailed tree PA04

papers.title: Single-cell multiomics analysis reveals dynamic clonal evolution and targetable phenotypes in acute myeloid leukemia with complex karyotype
papers.material: human patient; separate PDX and relapse samples
papers.long_feature: chromosome-scale haplotype via short-read strand inheritance
papers.tree_evidence: scTRIP SV/CN genotypes and manually curated clonal trees

papers.title: Multiomic single cell sequencing identifies stemlike nature of mixed phenotype acute leukemia
papers.single_cell: targeted scDNA and surface proteins; scRNA separate
papers.long_feature: SNV genotypes; no native long reads

papers.title: Long-read sequencing of single cell-derived melanoma sublines reveals divergent and parallel genomic and epigenomic evolutionary trajectories
papers.long_feature: ONT SNV/SV/CN/methylation; insufficient germline heterozygosity for phasing
papers.tree_evidence: ScisTree ONT SNV tree; TreeHarmonizer fixed-topology placement

papers.title: Co-evolution of tumor and immune cells during progression of multiple myeloma
papers.long_feature: 10x linked short reads, haplotype and somatic co-occurrence
papers.tree_evidence: local subclone relationship constraints; no independent scDNA tree

papers.title: Single-cell genomic variation induced by mutational processes in cancer
papers.material: isogenic cell lines; human tissue and PDX
papers.long_feature: SIGNALS haplotype-specific CN; ONT validates selected SVs
papers.tree_evidence: total-CN breakpoint tree; ONT not direct topology input

papers.title: Phasing analysis of lung cancer genomes using a long read sequencer
papers.single_cell: scDNA in S8/S20; topology selection in different case S14
papers.long_feature: ONT same-read mutation pairs, haplotype blocks
papers.tree_evidence: partial orders constrain bulk ClonEvol alternatives; sparse scDNA validation

papers.title: MEDICC2: whole-genome doubling aware copy-number phylogenies for cancer evolution
papers.long_feature: haplotype-specific CN/LOH/WGD; no native long reads
papers.tree_evidence: minimum-event distance and de novo CN phylogeny

papers.title: Multisite long-read sequencing reveals the early contributions of somatic structural variations to HBV-related hepatocellular carcinoma tumorigenesis
papers.long_feature: ONT SV breakpoint presence; modified SVclone CCF
papers.tree_evidence: neighbor-joining sample tree, not deconvolved clone tree

papers.title: Haplotype-aware analysis of somatic copy number variations from single-cell transcriptomes
papers.pdf_title: Haplotype-enhanced inference of somatic copy number profiles from single-cell transcriptomes
papers.material: human patient; NCI-N87 cell line added in formal version
papers.long_feature: population-based haplotype, allele counts and expression; no native long reads
papers.tree_evidence: iterative CNV genotype and maximum-likelihood phylogeny

papers.title: Intratumoral Heterogeneity and Clonal Evolution Induced by HPV Integration
papers.material: human primary tumors and cell lines
papers.long_feature: ONT/PacBio HPV-human integration and rearrangement molecules
papers.tree_evidence: local structural molecular ancestry/history; not full clone-tree inference
